specificWowContext.rule: A succeeded backend job may still contain a labeled deterministic fallback after model timeout. The UI may show that backend-returned bounded checklist only with its low-confidence and missing-evidence labels.

trustRules: The target's profession, specialization, scene, evidence status, timestamps, user portrait, conversation history, source references and source count are placeholders and never runtime facts.

The target defines twelve stable first-level regions: page, header, workbench context, intro, two user-turn positions, two assistant-answer positions, evidence boundary, answer state, topic library and composer.

URL workbench context is bounded app context, not verified evidence. The route maps scenario to the backend-owned scenarioKey field and may seed labels and the backend request, but it cannot authorize DPS, rank, BiS, official-source or player-identity claims.
A fresh route begins with one app-authored evidence-boundary introduction and no fabricated user question, assistant answer, timestamp or prior conversation.

Conversation slots show at most the latest two real user/assistant turns while retaining the bounded session id for subsequent backend messages. Empty slots remain visibly empty and never impersonate message history.

Only a non-fallback chickenbro.messages response may append its assistantMessage. A transport fallback retains the real user turn, exposes retry in answer_failure_panel and must not append the API client's frontend fallback as an assistant answer.

Backend deterministic_fallback and deterministic_scope_refusal answers are displayable only with answerSource, confidence, basisLabel, missingInputs, limitations and evidenceRefs from the same response.

Evidence rows come only from assistantMessage.payload.evidenceRefs. Zero returned refs keeps two stable unavailable positions and cannot synthesize source names, URLs, official status or a source count.
Priority actions, missing-input chips, limitation chips and next question come only from the latest backend payload. Known codes may receive a Chinese display label without changing their meaning.
The route has no registered session-history, upload, URL-ingestion or external topic-library endpoint. The topic-library region is a local safe-prompt picker, not a claim that stored topics exist.
Message input is trimmed and capped at 2000 characters, duplicate sends are disabled while waiting, and new topic clears local turns and session id without claiming server-side deletion.

The typed API rejects malformed session ids, message roles or content, action rows, evidence references and evidence-boundary arrays instead of rendering partial transport data as an assistant answer.
Loading, empty, blocked and error states retain all twelve regions; state copy inhabits target-owned slots instead of mounting AssistantRoute, ChatShell, WowPanel, EvidenceLedger or RouteStatePanel.

bounded query context, latest backend evidence state and real workbench navigation
first of the latest two real user turns or a neutral empty slot

stateContract.initial: mount all twelve regions with one intro, empty turn slots, bounded context, empty evidence positions and an enabled composer
stateContract.sending: retain geometry, append only the real user turn, disable duplicate send and mark answer state waiting
stateContract.ready: append the backend assistantMessage and derive evidence, missing inputs, limitations and source labels from its payload
stateContract.bounded_fallback: show a backend deterministic fallback only with low or blocked confidence and the same response's evidence boundary
stateContract.transport_error: do not synthesize an assistant turn; retain user text and enable retry in answer_failure_panel
stateContract.retry: resubmit the exact last real user message and preserve the existing session id when available
stateContract.new_topic: clear local turns, draft, last submission and session id; preserve route context and stable geometry
